fields.options: Configure your Twilio account for outbound SMS + Verify (OTP) flows. Auth token is stored encrypted via frappe.utils.password and is never returned by API.

fields.label: Account SID
fields.description: Twilio Account SID begins with 'AC' followed by 32 hex characters. Obtain it from the Twilio console dashboard.

fields.label: Auth Token
fields.description: Twilio Auth Token. Stored encrypted. Never exposed via API.

fields.label: Default Sender (E.164)
fields.description: Default Twilio phone number in E.164 format (e.g. +15555550100).

fields.label: Status Callback URL
fields.description: Public URL Twilio calls with delivery receipts. Auto-populated from request host on save.

fields.label: Inbound Webhook URL
fields.description: Public URL Twilio calls for SMS received on a Twilio number (two-way + STOP keywords).

fields.label: Sandbox Fail-Open (dev only)
fields.description: Skip the actual Twilio HTTP call and log every send as Sandbox. Server logs an audit event for every send. NEVER enable in production.

fields.label: Verify Service SID (optional)
fields.description: Twilio Verify Service SID (starts with 'VA'). Optional — when set, OTP can use the Verify API instead of self-issued HMAC codes.

fields.label: Max SMS per phone per day
fields.description: Soft rate-limit applied to non-OTP sends per recipient phone number.
